events.title: DECC Gala: a Progressive Party Through the Decades
events.description: The First-Ever DECC Gala: a Progressive Party through the Decades We're excited to announce the inaugural DECC Gala, a one-of-a-kind celebration honoring the 60th Anniversary of the DECC. This isn't your typical gala because the DECC, with 10 community venues, is anything but typical. Guests will embark on a progressive journey through the decades and across the DECC campus, experiencing the history of the organization in a truly immersive way.
